## Documentation Compliance (Mandatory)

- [ ] **Technical Doc / ADR Created or Updated:**

  - *OR* [ ] Exempt: This is a trivial bug fix, typo, or minor chore not changing architecture or public contracts.
- [ ] Architecture diagrams updated (if system interaction changed).
